env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos eject -o out
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/sync/sync.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/arena/arena.go

cd out
go test -v ./...
stdout '^--- PASS: TestInPackageSupport '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestExternalSupport '

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/testsupport

go 1.27

-- m/anchor.go --
package testsupport

const Input = "ABC"

-- m/anchor_test.go --
package testsupport

import (
	"testing"

	"logos/sync"
)

func TestInPackageSupport(t *testing.T) {
	var locked sync.Locked[string]
	locked.WithLock(func(value *string) {
		*value = Input
	})
	var got string
	locked.WithLock(func(value *string) {
		got = *value
	})
	if got != Input {
		t.Fatalf("locked value = %q, want %q", got, Input)
	}
}

-- m/arena_test.go --
package testsupport_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/testsupport"
	"logos/arena"
)

func TestExternalSupport(t *testing.T) {
	region := arena.Open()
	got := arena.Make[byte](region, 2)
	if len(got) != 2 || got[0] != 0 || got[1] != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("arena.Make[byte](region, 2) = %v, want [0 0]", got)
	}
	copy(got, testsupport.Input)
	if string(got) != "AB" {
		t.Fatalf("copied arena slice = %q, want %q", got, "AB")
	}
}
